videoUrl.title: YouTube video URL
videoUrl.description: Single video URL. Supports watch?v=, youtu.be/, and /shorts/ formats. Use videoUrls for batch processing.

videoUrls.title: YouTube video URLs (batch)
videoUrls.description: Process multiple videos in one run. Accepts an array of YouTube URLs in any supported format.

preferredLanguage.title: Preferred transcript languages (ordered)
preferredLanguage.description: Language codes in priority order, e.g. ["en", "en-US"]. Falls back to any available language if none match.

languagePreference.title: Preferred transcript languages (legacy alias)
languagePreference.description: Deprecated alias for preferredLanguage. Use preferredLanguage instead.

removeBrackets.title: Remove bracketed non-speech markers
removeBrackets.description: Strip annotations like [Music] or [Applause] from the transcript.

outputMode.title: Output mode
outputMode.description: text_only returns transcriptText. text_and_segments also includes the segments array with per-segment timestamps.

proxyMode.title: Proxy mode
proxyMode.description: auto tries datacenter first, then residential. Requires APIFY_TOKEN for anything other than off.

maxRetries.title: Max retries per proxy mode
maxRetries.description: Number of attempts per proxy tier before giving up or switching to the next tier.

timeoutMs.title: Per-request timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: Maximum time in milliseconds for a single yt-dlp process.

timeoutSecs.title: Per-request timeout (seconds)
timeoutSecs.description: Alternative to timeoutMs. Ignored if timeoutMs is set.

saveVttToKV.title: Save raw VTT to Key-Value Store
saveVttToKV.description: Stores the original VTT file in the actor's key-value store and adds vttKvKey to the output.

debug.title: Debug logging
debug.description: Enables verbose yt-dlp command logging and per-attempt failure messages.
